en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a busy street scene in front of an ornate city gate with Renaissance architecture. The gate has a large central archway for traffic, two stories of windows supported by columns, balustrades with statues, and a steep roof topped by a tower and spires. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand on the cobbled street with tram tracks. At the top in red print it reads "Danzig. Langgasser Tor." and there is additional small printing along the left edge and architectural Latin inscriptions above the arch.
